events.quote: Before one thing (a singular noun) we always put a or an
Use an before a vowel sound (an apple, an egg) and a before a consonant sound
"a book", not "book"
After he, she or it, the verb takes -s
Add -es after sh, ch, s, x and o ... Do not add -s after I, you, we or they.
"She likes tea", not "She like tea"
Right: "She watches TV." Wrong: "She watchs TV."

next_task.correct: My mother watches TV every morning.

errors.W1: My mother watch TV every morning.
errors.W2: My mother watchs TV every morning.
